newsitem.title: UK: UK Friends Provident Stewardship fund in AA rating.
newsitem.headline: UK Friends Provident Stewardship fund in AA rating.

text.p: The Stewardship Trust, the flagship ethical fund from Friends Provident, has been awarded a AA rating from UK fund consultancy Fund Research Limited.
A statement said the 342.5 million stg fund, which includes the Stewardship Life Fund of 186 million stg, said it was the first ethical unit trust to receive any kind of rating from Fund Research.

The rating was based on "conservative, disciplined and effective management style", the statement said, along with "impressive performance". The fund has outperformed the Hoare Govett Smaller Companies Index and the FTSE-A All Share index, while keeping volatility low.
Phil White, assistant product manager at Stewardship, said the award underlined "what we and our customers have known for years, that it is possible to invest ethically and achieve a recent return."
